{{Quote|Brosh, your charric. Set for level two.|General Soontir Fel, to Brosh|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Charric pistols''',<ref name="DK III: SW" /> also known as the '''Chiss hand weapons''', or simply '''charrics''',<ref name="VotF" /> were a type of [[Charric/Legends|charric]].<ref name="DK III: SW" /> They were used by [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warrior]]s of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="OF" />

[[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] carried<ref name="OF" /> a [[Mitth'ras'safis's charric|charric]]<ref name="SQ" /> concealed in his tunic<ref name="OF" /> that was adorned with [[Written Cheunh|Chiss lettering]],<ref name="SQ" /> when he boarded the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' with [[Jorj Car'das]]<ref name="OF" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="OF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> his weapon was recovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]].<ref name="SQ" />
